messages:
maya: quick proposal 90min sync ahead: want to run a cross-environment canary for redwood-7b-v3 AWQ-int8 and GPTQ-int8 variants. goal: validate accuracy deltas, perf wins, and rollout/fallback paths for hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.
kenji: SGTM. can we separate acceptance criteria per environment? private customers often have stricter accuracy SLAs.
eva: yes. suggested splits: hosted tolerates slightly larger quality delta if perf wins; dedicated similar but notify account owner; private = manual opt-in only unless SOC signoff.
simon: also flag that AWQ tends to change tokenization behavior in a few edge prompts (we saw truncation on some chain-of-thought replies). include a format-preservation check and trimmed-length histogram.
maya: good call. here's my draft acceptance matrix (draft):
- hosted: MMLU >= baseline -0.6 pts; GSM8K >= baseline -1.0 pts; truthfulness drop <= 1.0% abs; p50 <= 0.85x; p95 <= 1.25x
- dedicated: MMLU >= baseline -0.5; GSM8K >= baseline -0.8; truthfulness drop <= 0.8%; p50 <= 0.88x; p95 <= 1.2x
- private: block auto-push; run private-staging canary with customer sample, require SOC & account approval if any quality delta > -0.4
kenji: add automated checks:
- token-length distribution shift > 3% trigger
- top-1 logprob gap > 0.2 average trigger
- hallucination proxy (embedding sim) drop > 1.5% trigger
eva: and add per-prompt rollback flags for arithmetic tasks (GSM8K). numeric exactness matters more than soft accuracy for those. propose a separate numeric-exactness pass@1 threshold.
simon: propose fallback chain: {awq-int8, gptq-int8, fp16-compile}. if awq fails but gptq passes, route to gptq for the affected route. record fallback reason in logs with model_hash and compile_flags.
maya: agreed. canary rollout plan (config snippet):
```
canary_profile: {
  environments: [hosted, dedicated, private-staging],
  initial_weights: {hosted:0.5%, dedicated:0.5%},
  step_doubling: twice/day until 8%,
  hold_conditions: [mmlu_delta <= -0.5, gsm8k_delta <= -0.8, truth_drop >= 0.8%],
  rollback_conditions: [mmlu_delta <= -0.9, error_rate > 0.4%, p95 > 1.5x],
  fallback_chain: [gptq-int8, fp16-compile],
  observability: [eval-suite, topk-logprobs-sample, token-length-hist, per-route-traces]
}
```
bench-bot: queued full eval: https://ci.redwood/examples/onboard/1769987654/variants (runs: mmlu, hellaswag, gsm8k-numeric, truthfulness, prod-sample-7d).
bench-bot: quick summary (hosted/us initial=0.5%): MMLU delta -0.48, HellaSwag +0.2, GSM8K delta -0.95, truthfulness -0.7%, p50 0.82x, p95 1.15x, exceptions 0.06%, token-cost -29%.
maya: GSM8K -0.95 is slightly outside hosted acceptance (-1.0 is the boundary but this is close). need the numeric-exactness pass to see if it's formatting vs calculation.
kenji: running targeted gsm8k-numeric (canonicalized answers, longer chain-of-thought prompts removed) now against gptq-int8 and fp16-compile for comparison.
eva: also run trimmed-length histogram and topk logprob diff sample (1k samples). if awq compresses outputs, pass@1 may look lower even if answer semantically same.
simon: note: dedicated clusters using A100-p4 show slightly different perf/quant behavior than hosted gpus. label results by hardware.
maya: deploying hosted/us canary at 0.5% now. deploy-bot, apply canary_profile and wire alerting to #eng-ml for the first 4 hours.
deploy-bot: scheduling canary: model=redwood-7b-v3-awq-int8, scope=hosted/us, weight=0.5%, config_id=cfg-1769987654-a
deploy-bot: integrations: /bench-bot, /trace, /alerts; streaming to #eng-ml.
bench-bot: 45m update (sample=3k): MMLU -0.46, GSM8K -0.92, numeric-exactness pass@1: -0.08 (small), trimmed-length shift +1.8%, top1-logprob-gap avg +0.18.
maya: numeric-exactness small delta suggests formatting contributes. kenji: what does GPTQ look like on the same numeric pass?
kenji: GPTQ-int8 numeric-exactness pass@1 delta: -0.02 vs fp16; GSM8K overall -0.35; p50 0.90x; p95 1.12x.
eva: interesting: awq gives better throughput but more formatting variance; gptq safer for arithmetic. suggest hybrid route policy: for routes tagged "numeric" or route-level regex matching arithmetic prompts, prefer gptq-int8; otherwise awq-int8 by default.
simon: implement route preference with per-route priority weights and failover to fallback_chain if health checks fail. add canary annotation in rollout UI.
maya: please do not auto-push to private. Eva, prepare private-staging playbook and customer notification template if we plan to propose conversion to private.
eva: will draft playbook and template, include SOC checklist. target: next week. :memo:
kenji: starting ablation probe for AWQ layers that may alter output formatting. will post results in thread.
simon: small ops note: add variant_reason tag in request logs so account teams can correlate regressions.
maya: thanks all. if numbers remain stable at 1% after the next burst, we'll proceed with dedicated canary next week and keep private as manual. will update thread. :thumbsup:
